race.description: The Wharf Mooloolaba Swiss Ace Plate (L)
race.comment: Tough to assess with a few handy ones resuming. PAYLINE (6) and HIDDEN WEALTH (3) are two of those and have trialled up strongly in readiness. Their runs G3 W.J Healy before the break were super and they have a depth of ratings good enough to take this out. Perhaps a slight lean to PAYLINE from the more favourable draw. WANDA ROX (13) only had the one crack last prep, finishing midfield here in what was a strong form reference. His prep two back was strong and recent trials suggests he's come back in good nick. MOULIN MISS (14) is race fit and is drawn to advantage down in the weights. Can steal it if left alone in front.
